import time
import numpy as np
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.run_tuning_curve import setup_sweep_artifacts
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.constants import TrialMode, V_INIT_MV
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.trial import run_one_trial
artifacts = setup_sweep_artifacts()
from neuron import h
h.cvode.active(True)
soma = artifacts.cell.soma
ais = artifacts.cell.axon_initial_segment
# Boost only AIS, with carefully tuned el to maintain rest
# Strategy: increase AIS gnabar substantially but compensate with more gleak by lowering Rm only on AIS
# Actually let's just increase gl_hh on AIS and soma
soma.gnabar_hh = 0.3
soma.gkbar_hh = 0.04
soma.gl_hh = 0.001
soma.el_hh = -65.0
ais.gnabar_hh = 1.5
ais.gkbar_hh = 0.04
ais.gl_hh = 0.001
ais.el_hh = -65.0
ais.L = 50.0

v_rec = h.Vector()
v_rec.record(soma(0.5)._ref_v)
h.finitialize(V_INIT_MV)
h.continuerun(50.0)
v = np.array(list(v_rec))
print(f'quiescent v_final={v[-1]:.2f}')

for (mode, angle) in [(TrialMode.AMPA_ONLY, 0), (TrialMode.AMPA_ONLY, 90), (TrialMode.AMPA_ONLY, 180), (TrialMode.FULL, 0), (TrialMode.FULL, 90), (TrialMode.FULL, 180)]:
    t0 = time.time()
    res = run_one_trial(h=h, cell=artifacts.cell, pairs=artifacts.pairs, mode=mode, angle_deg=float(angle), trial_seed=1)
    print(f'{mode.value} {angle}: t={time.time()-t0:.2f}s n_spikes={len(res.spike_times_ms)} v_max={res.v_soma_mv.max():.2f}')
